context: R41 Linux updater revision authority fix

records.claimDecision: R40/Linux R13 updater false-positive is a product bug, not an external-service artifact.
records.evidenceSource: Live installed update_check: current=4.2.0-linux.13-r40, localRevision=12, remoteRevision=13, updateAvailable=true; route/tun unchanged.

records.claimDecision: Do not mutate published R40/R13 asset; create Linux R14 under R41.
records.evidenceSource: Published v4.2.0-r40-final already carries accepted digests; revision bump avoids mutable-release ambiguity.

records.claimDecision: Minimum sufficient fix is dynamic VERSION-derived local revision + fail-closed malformed version + CI current-builder guard.
records.evidenceSource: Focused regression PASS; no Windows runtime mutation required.

records.claimDecision: R41 source candidate passed full local gate before promotion.
records.evidenceSource: 181/181 pytest PASS; public-tree verifier PASS; security scan zero hits; Linux R14 package deterministic build PASS.

records.claimDecision: Linux R14 exact live acceptance closed the R40 false-update regression.
records.evidenceSource: Exact package B3FD52...FF984 installed; 9/9 integrity; local14 vs public remote13 => updateAvailable=false; route and external tun0 unchanged.

records.claimDecision: R41 source commit passed hosted CI #148 including aggregate virtual acceptance.
R41 public release is accepted on main and published with exact digests.
records.evidenceSource: main 967fe592; v4.2.0-r41-final; Windows C64CC9...17F32 and Linux B3FD52...FF984.

records.claimDecision: Post-merge CI #151 first Android emulator attempt was infrastructure-transient, not a product regression.
records.evidenceSource: First job passed build/install and real VPN consent stages then failed only with 'adb: device offline'; targeted same-commit retry on a fresh runner passed the complete Android runtime and aggregate virtual-acceptance.

records.claimDecision: Post-publish update semantics are closed for both installed desktop authorities.
records.evidenceSource: Windows local40/remote40 no-update with unchanged Ethernet route; Linux local14/remote14 no-update, 9/9 integrity, unchanged routes and external tun0.

records.evidenceSource: v4.2.0-r41-final targets 967fe592...; PR #19 control/evidence-only merge advanced main to f56d8d30... without runtime changes.

records.claimDecision: CI #160 Android failure is not evidence of a product regression; it is a probable UI hierarchy readiness race after a successful Activity launch.
records.evidenceSource: Run #160/job 110053208621: emulator/ADB/build/install succeeded and am start -W returned Status: ok; first UI hierarchy was pulled, then the expected text assertion failed. Android official docs distinguish launch completion from UI-state waiting and recommend timeout/stability waits in UI Automator.

records.claimDecision: Use bounded state polling inside the Android emulator harness instead of rerunning the whole hosted job.
records.evidenceSource: dump_until_contains retries only hierarchy acquisition/state publication for up to 15 seconds, preserves all product assertions, fails closed with diagnostics, and is regression-guarded.

records.claimDecision: Android UI hierarchy synchronization hardening is accepted.
records.evidenceSource: Fresh hosted CI #162 on head 7bb945a passed android-emulator-runtime directly without manual rerun; iOS simulator and aggregate virtual-acceptance also passed.
